caption: The video captures a close side view of a transparent vessel holding a clear liquid. A softly blurred outdoor backdrop of dark and greenish tones fills the background. A thick, irregular bed of small bubbles lines the bottom edge, its upper boundary broken into little columns and peaks. This froth shows subtle changes, with its little peaks and bubbles varying in detail. Above the bed, numerous tiny bright bubbles are scattered through the liquid, mostly holding their positions, with only slight changes. A horizontal white streak runs across the upper-left, and a few larger droplets cling to the left wall, remaining largely stable throughout. The camera framing and background stay essentially steady, keeping the focus on the slowly evolving bubbly texture.
